import pygame
pygame.init\(\)
screen = pygame.display.set_mode\(\(100, 100\)\)

from renderer3d.context import GLContext
from renderer3d.camera import OrbitCamera
from renderer3d.plate_renderer import PlateRenderer3D

# Create dummy surfaces
earth = pygame.Surface\(\(420, 420\), pygame.SRCALPHA\)
earth.fill\(\(50, 15, 15\)\)
heaven = pygame.Surface\(\(420, 420\), pygame.SRCALPHA\)
pygame.draw.circle\(heaven, \(10, 10, 12\), \(210, 210\), 210\)

gl = GLContext\(800, 800, samples=4\)
cam = OrbitCamera\(\)
pr = PlateRenderer3D\(gl.ctx, earth, heaven\)

# Render a frame
vp = cam.get_vp_matrix\(1.0\)
cam_pos = cam.get_eye_position\(\)
gl.begin_frame\(\)
gl.ctx.enable\(gl.ctx.BLEND\)
gl.ctx.blend_func = \(gl.ctx.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ctx.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA\)
pr.render_earth\(vp, cam_pos\)
pr.render_shadow\(vp\)
pr.render_heaven\(vp, cam_pos, 0.0\)
surf = gl.end_frame\(\)
print\(f''Surface size: {surf.get_size\(\)}''\)

# Test get_heaven_model
model = pr.get_heaven_model\(45.0\)
print\(f''Heaven model shape: {model.shape}, dtype: {model.dtype}''\)
print\(f''Heaven Y: {pr.heaven_y:.3f}''\)

pr.release\(\)
gl.release\(\)
pygame.quit\(\)
print\(''Dome pipeline OK''\)
")
